title: PM's 8AM Class
text: 8AM on the plateau. The Saclay wind is trying to remove your eyebrows, and PM is already at the board, cheerful, as if 8AM were a reasonable hour. Do you go?
speaker: pm

hints: The professor is only ever called PM. Year 1, CentraleSupélec campus at Saclay. First of two 8AM classes: keep it light.

effects.text: PM nods at you. You take notes. Some of them are even legible.

choices.label: Skip, sleep
choices.hint: Your duvet makes a strong case

effects.text: You sleep until 11. Somewhere, PM writes something important on the board.

title: The ESSEC Asso Fair
text: Year 2: you've swapped the plateau for Cergy, and the ESSEC asso fair is everything you waited for. Crêpes, drums, a rugby scrum near the lake and forty stands that all claim to be 'a family'. You held out a whole year. Time to choose.

hints: The player skipped the CentraleSupélec clubs in Year 1 to wait for the ESSEC assos in Cergy: this is the payoff.
The asso friend (Malik) is met here if the player joins any asso.

choices.label: No association after all
choices.hint: More sleep, more study, fewer stories

effects.text: You walk past the stands, crêpe in hand, with the focus of someone who owns a library card.

title: Sète Tonight?
text: Year 2, another Thursday, another theme: 'business casual but make it chaos'. Someone has rented a péniche on the Seine. Your energy bar is blinking orange. Are you in?

variants.text: Of course there's a sète tonight. There's always a sète tonight. People now ask you where it is. Someone has rented a péniche on the Seine and your name is on the guest list twice. Are you in?

effects.text: The péniche sways. So do you.
You're asleep by eleven. Your future self sends a silent thank-you.

title: 3AM
text: 3AM on the edge of the péniche's deck. The music is still going, but you're deep in a great conversation with someone you just met, about AI, free will and the best kebab in Paris, while the Seine pretends to be romantic. Home, or one more hour?
speaker: stranger_3am

hints: Never gender the stranger (Noa). If the player stays, this person can come back at 30.

effects.text: You catch the first train home and watch the sunrise from a nearly empty carriage.
One more hour turns into breakfast. Some people just make time disappear.

title: PM Looks Straight at You
text: Last 8AM before the Year 1 finals. You reach the door at 8:04. PM stops mid-sentence and looks straight at you. So does the whole amphitheatre. Walk in, or vanish?
speaker: pm

variants.text: Last 8AM before the Year 1 finals. You're in your usual seat, of course. PM pauses, looks straight at you: 'At least someone has been here every single time.' Stay for the whole thing?

hints: Second and last 8AM (it does not always happen): PM looks straight at the player. PM will remember this for decades.

effects.text: PM gives you a tiny nod. It will matter, years later.
You walk to the front under thirty stares. PM smiles: 'Better late than absent.'
You close the door very softly. PM's eyebrows will remember this.

title: The New aiPhone Just Dropped
text: The new aiPhone just dropped. It has a fourth camera, a 'pro' button and a colour called Midnight Sage. Yours works perfectly, apart from a crack you stopped noticing months ago. Upgrade?

effects.text: It's beautiful. It is exactly like the old one. You love it.
Last year's aiPhone, half the price. Nobody can tell, least of all you.
You buy a cheap case and feel like a financial genius.

title: Grounded
text: Clearing out a drawer, you find your old passport, barely stamped. You've seen the world by train, bus, bike and night ferry. You never once needed a boarding pass.

effects.text: A whole life without flying. Not a sacrifice, it turns out: a style.
